key_custody: 32-byte master key and 16-byte deployment ID supplied outside database; single key version; no KMS/rotation/memory erasure
envelope: ACV1 || uint32be(1) || nonce[12] || ciphertext || tag[16]; 36-byte overhead

widths.snapshot: N categorical bytes; count values 0/1, histogram values 0..B

aad.snapshot: mixed-snapshot plus tenant, domain, snapshot ID, accountant and public shape; distinguishes count/histogram and catalog order
aad.private_state: mixed-job-state plus operation identity/shape, queue sequence, exact public work and pc

checks: Internal action bytes hash must match persisted digest before secret use
Catalog JSON canonical order/labels and SHA-256 match public digest
Exact plaintext width and value ranges revalidated after successful AEAD authentication
Result must match contextual HMAC; bare hash/token substitution rejected

Storage profile and key-check revalidated each transaction; old/plain services and wrong deployment/key reject
atomicity: AEAD seals before SQL write; entire result, all domain/ancestor charges and final private checkpoint remain in scheduler transaction
private_progress: Full tape L1 commits before snapshot read; later ticks keep exact tape; no partial output release; corruption never triggers reseed/refund/empty-state fallback

verification.whole_database_rollback_negative_control: Consistent pre-L1 database copy reopens and audits after a later completed job; rollback remains undetected
